mapper.select:
SELECT BD.BRD_NO, BD.BRD_CODE, BD.BRD_TITL_NM, BD.BRD_CONT, BD.BRD_PBLS_DTM, BD.BRD_VW_CNT, BD.BRD_END_DTM, BD.BRD_DEL_YN, BD.BRD_CTGRY_GRP_CD, MEM.MBR_ID, MEM.MBR_CD, C.CODE_NAME AS BRD_CODE_NAME, FAQ.FAQ_ID, FAQ.FAQ_CTGRY, FAQ.FAQ_TITL, FAQ.FAQ_CONT, FAQ.FAQ_CNT, FAQ.FAQ_YN, FAQ.FAQ_MBR_ID, FAQ.FAQ_CRE_DTM, FAQ.FAQ_MOD_DTM, QNA.QNA_ID, QNA.QNA_CTGRY, QNA.QNA_TITL, QNA.QNA_CONT, QNA.ANSWER_CONT, QNA.QNA_STATUS, QNA.QNA_YN, QNA.QNA_CRE_DTM, QNA.QNA_MOD_DTM, QNA.QNA_ANSWERED_AT, QNA.MBR_CD AS QNA_MBR_CD, QNA.ANSWER_ADMIN_ID
FROM BOARD BD LEFT JOIN MEMBER MEM ON BD.MBR_CD = MEM.MBR_CD LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE C ON C.CODE_GROUP = 'BRDCT' AND C.CODE_VALUE = BD.BRD_CODE LEFT JOIN FAQ FAQ ON BD.BRD_NO = FAQ.BRD_NO LEFT JOIN QNA QNA ON BD.BRD_NO = QNA.BRD_NO WHERE BD.BRD_NO = #{brdNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET BRD_TITL_NM = #{brdTitlNm}, BRD_CONT = #{brdCont}, BRD_MOD_DTM = SYSDATE, BRD_CTGRY_GRP_CD = #{brdCtgryGrpCd}, BRD_END_DTM = #{brdEndDtm} WHERE BRD_NO = #{brdNo} AND BRD_DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE BOARD SET BRD_DEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE BRD_NO = #{brdNo} AND BRD_DEL_YN = 'N'
